bloc.Enveloppe d’investissement et DPGF — déc: Investment envelope and DPGF — GO / NO-GO decision
bloc.Les pays se comparent sur le coût total: Countries are compared on total cost of ownership: it is the only figure that separates them, the investment being identical by construction. Value creation is read in EVA, ROCE and free cash flow. Each quantity carries its nature and its source; the items that the reference framework cannot decide remain displayed empty, with the question to ask — hiding them would give the illusion of a complete decision.
bloc.L’avis GO / NO GO reposait sur cinq cons:
The GO / NO-GO opinion rested on five findings, and they were all on the supply side: does the budget hold, is the costing complete enough, will the grid keep up, is the timetable realistic, will the site be compliant. None asked whether anyone will lease. Eight tests are added — contracted demand, timetable against access to electricity, economic robustness, end-client needs, announced competition in the area, greenfield or brownfield, modularity and phasing, financial risks covered — and they feed into the same verdict: a file has only one, and two separate opinions would end up contradicting each other.

The figure that decides is the break-even occupancy rate. A margin calculated at full load says nothing — every project is profitable when full; what is asked in committee is from what occupancy level the site covers its costs, and how far away from it you are. No price is built in: without a declared hosting price, break-even is stated as undetermined rather than calculated on a default value — that nobody contests.

texte.C'est ce que ce moteur tient et qu'un ta: This is what this engine holds and a spreadsheet does not: it knows the uncertainty of its quantities. An envelope at ±# % that exceeds its target by # % has crossed nothing — the gap is within the noise. Red requires an overrun greater than both the tolerance and the uncertainty; in between, the status shown is “gap not demonstrated”. Without this rule, the third false positive switches off vigilance on all the others.

texte.L’eau de FABRICATION du matériel n’est c: The water used to MANUFACTURE the hardware is counted nowhere — neither here nor in the upstream inventory. A semiconductor plant consumes around # million litres of ultrapure water per day; the share attributable to one server cannot be reconstructed without manufacturer data, and manufacturers do not publish it. The manufacturing item above therefore carries embodied CARBON, never embodied water.
texte.L’eau de la colonne ci-contre est celle: The water in the adjacent column is COOLING water, and only that. The water consumed upstream to produce the electricity — considerable for thermal and nuclear — is not added to it, so as not to mix two responsibilities: it is calculated and published SEPARATELY, in the “water that WUE does not count” inventory in this same section. On the national estates where both terms are published, upstream weighs eight to twelve times the site.

texte.SCOPE # HORS PÉRIMÈTRE. Ces chiffres cou: SCOPE # OUT OF SCOPE. These figures cover the electricity consumed (scope # of the GHG Protocol) and the amortised hardware (scope #). They include NEITHER refrigerant leaks NOR generator fuel — the two direct items of a data centre, and on a direct-expansion site refrigerant leakage regularly exceeds fuel. These values can only be obtained on the site itself: refrigerant charge, leak rate, diesel volume. For a third-party site observed from outside, they are not accessible and are therefore not estimated. A complete company inventory requires them: this map does not replace a BEGES [French regulatory greenhouse gas emissions report].
